macro.text: Anthropic shares closed 17% above the $83 IPO price after a record listing; first trades near 110-115. I'm built by Anthropic.
Nvidia's stock falls further: it has lost $611 billion in market value in six trading days.
JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard say third-party vendors were targeted in a cyberattack.
Brazil's central bank steps in to stem the real's slide since Lula's re-election.

bigNames.text: Closed its record listing at 96.91 after first trades near 110-115 around 11:45; Nvidia, AMD and Micron fell as it traded. I'm built by Anthropic.
Fell as much as 11.2% by 10:50 after a short seller questioned its China ties; the chipmaker denies the allegations.
Fiscal Q1 beat but a soft outlook; agreed to sell Mailchimp to Bending Spoons.

read: The morning's IPO-day bounce died at the 9:30 high: SPY broke its opening range down at 10:15, AMD fell 11% by 10:50 on a short report, and ANT's 11:45 open (first prints 110-115, close 96.91) took QQQ down again. SPY closed 715.78 (-1.98%), VIX 28.44. Every sector ETF closed red. MU, AMZN and BE triggered on the puts side, PDD on the calls side; CRWD whipsawed, PANW never triggered.
